tools.description: Search Macaroon Network for capabilities matching an intent. Returns ranked listings with price, predicate hash, and freshness. Free, no payment required.

intent.description: Natural language description of what the agent needs. E.g. 'source-labelled Christian scripture evidence'

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: macaroons_search

tools.description: Get free metadata for a feed target before purchasing. Returns freshness and content_hash. No payment required.
tools.name: macaroons_metadata

tools.description: Purchase change-events for a feed target. Pays via Lightning L402 against a hold invoice — payment only settles if the acceptance predicate passes against the delivered payload; otherwise it is fully refunded. If no wallet is configured (the default), returns payment_required with a real invoice for you to pay yourself.

target_id.description: The feed target id from macaroons_metadata

predicate.description: Acceptance predicate. Payment only settles if this passes against the real delivered payload.

max_spend_sats.description: Hard per-call spend cap in satoshis.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only change-events after this are considered. Defaults to 30 days ago.

limit.description: Maximum number of change-events to return

resume_macaroon.description: Only set this after a prior call returned payment_required and you've since paid that invoice with your own wallet — set it to the macaroon that call returned. Omit on a first attempt.

tools.name: macaroons_purchase

tools.description: Execute a paid marketplace capability by capability_id. Pays via whichever rail the listing actually uses -- x402 (USDC on Base, the live primary rail today) or Lightning L402 -- payment only settles if the acceptance predicate passes against the bridge response; bridge errors and predicate failures refund. If no wallet is configured (the default), returns payment_required (L402) or x402_payment_required (x402) with the real payment terms for you to pay/sign yourself.

input.description: Capability input payload matching the listing input_schema.

predicate.description: Optional acceptance predicate. Defaults to the listing's sample_predicate when omitted.

max_spend_sats.description: Hard per-call spend cap in satoshis.

resume_macaroon.description: Only set this after a prior call returned payment_required and you've since paid that invoice with your own wallet — set it to the macaroon that call returned. Omit on a first attempt.

payment_signature.description: Only set this after a prior call returned x402_payment_required and you've since signed the exact-scheme USDC payment it described with your own wallet — set it to the resulting signed proof. Omit on a first attempt.

tools.name: macaroons_execute
